description: Expander for INTERMIX, placed immediately to the right of it, setting a separate crossfade time for each output.

params.text: Sets the crossfade time applied to the signal reaching that output when scenes change.

notes: detaching the expander, or pointing it at a different input column, returns every fade time to the value set on INTERMIX itself.
the times do nothing until an input column is chosen on the display's menu.
menu: Fade length — 4s, 15s or 60s, the longest fade these trimpots can set.
Mode — In & Out, In or Out, setting which direction of the crossfade these times apply to.
Input — on the display's own right-click menu, choosing which input column of INTERMIX these fade times belong to.
